query: What inter-lab QA/QC metrics, allowable percent bias, standards, and uncertainty-propagation rules are standard for trace-element and isotope analyses?

response.query: What inter-lab QA/QC metrics, allowable percent bias, standards, and uncertainty-propagation rules are standard for trace-element and isotope analyses?
response.answer: For trace-element and isotope analyses, inter-lab QA/QC typically allows a percent bias of ±10%, standards like NIST SRMs are used, and uncertainty propagation follows ISO/IEC 17025 guidelines.

results.content: "EFLM checklist for the assessment of AI/ML studies in laboratory medicine: enhancing general medical AI frameworks for laboratory-specific applications" *Clinical Chemistry and Laboratory Medicine (CCLM)*, vol. "EFLM checklist for the assessment of AI/ML studies in laboratory medicine: enhancing general medical AI frameworks for laboratory-specific applications" *Clinical Chemistry and Laboratory Medicine (CCLM)* 64, no. Carobene A, Cadamuro J, Frans G, Goldshmidt H, Debeljak Z, De Bruyne S, van Doorn W, Elias J, Özdemir H, Martin Perez S, Lame H, Tolios A, Cabitza F, Padoan A, On behalf of the European Federation of Clinical Chemistry and Laboratory Medicine Committee on Digitalisation and Artificial Intelligence. These extensions address: (1) explicit documentation of laboratory data characteristics; (2) consideration of biological and analytical variability; (3) the role of metadata and peridata in contextualizing results; (4) analyte harmonization and standardization practices; (5) rigorous external validation with attention to dataset similarity; and (6) the implementation of FAIR data principles for transparency and reproducibility.
